articles.title: One Popular PC Game Storefront Has Had Enough Of AI Slop, And It’s Taking Action
articles.summary: Indie game storefront Itch.io has announced it removed "a couple terabytes of AI slop" and has begun taking steps to combat the deluge of AI-created games appearing on the platform.
body: The platform had already noted that the number of game pages being created per day had doubled from 3,000 to 6,000 over the last two months, with reports of users flooding the game uploads page with dozens of AI-created game spams. Going forward, Itch says that these sorts of bulk uploads will result in that spam being de-indexed, and filtering for generative AI disclosure will be added more sections of the site, including the search results page.

This doesn't mean Itch is outright banning AI-generated content, but it is taking a harder line against people who spam the site with it. In its official terms and conditions, Itch states that if the use of AI in a game is "clearly stated" and if "it adds substantial value" to the user experience, then that's okay. But if you're uploading something iterative, that'll be against the platform's rules.
points: Indie game storefront Itch.io has announced it removed "a couple terabytes of AI slop" and has begun taking steps to combat the deluge of AI-created games appearing on the platform.

articles.title: GTA 6 Preload Times and Install Size Confirmed, Rockstar Announces Physical Cover Art Poster and Map of Leonida
articles.summary: Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload times as well as the install size of the game. Digital preloading on PS5 kicks off at midnight local time in your respective timezone on Tuesday, November 10, Rockstar said.
body: Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload and global release times as well as the install size of the game.
Rockstar has also now officially confirmed that GTA 6 itself launches globally on November 19, using the local midnight release timing strategy across PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.

As for the install size, Rockstar confirmed that the preload file weighs in at up to 212 GB, “depending on your device.” “So make sure you've got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible,” Rockstar said.

Elsewhere, Rockstar said that on November 19, the day GTA 6 comes out, it will add an official printable GTA 6 cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site. A double-sided physical version of this poster will also be made available shortly after launch from the Rockstar Store — for $0.99 on its own or as a free gift with any purchase from the Rockstar Store.

articles.title: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel Name, Logo, Officially Revealed as Bethesda Marks 40th Anniversary
articles.summary: Bethesda Game Studios has officially announced the subtitle for The Elder Scrolls 6. The long-awaited follow-up to Skyrim will be called Sentinel, making its official title The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel. A logo has also been revealed.
body: The confirmation follows a report from last week that has proven to be quite correct. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma got a demo of The Elder Scrolls VI earlier this summer, and teased the subtitle in her post by replacing the name we now know to be Sentinel with eight asterisks. Turns out those asterisks were very specific then, as Sentinel is of course eight letters.

It's been a long wait for The Elder Scrolls 6, as it was first announced way back in 2018, and fans have waited for more information on it ever since. Today's subtitle and logo reveal are the first real bits of news on it in quite some time, though we likely have at least a couple more years to wait before playing it. On Xbox and PC, that is. With Sharma's renewed focus on console exclusives, will The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel even see the light of day on a PlayStation console? That remains to be seen, but it's the biggest card Microsoft has to play in order to get more people back into its ecosystem.
For now, though, at least we've got the Sentinel name, and we'll have to cross our fingers that we get a proper reveal at next year's Xbox Showcase in June.
points: Bethesda Game Studios has officially announced the subtitle for The Elder Scrolls 6.
The long-awaited follow-up to Skyrim will be called Sentinel, making its official title The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel.
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma got a demo of The Elder Scrolls VI earlier this summer, and teased the subtitle in her post by replacing the name we now know to be Sentinel with eight asterisks.
It's been a long wait for The Elder Scrolls 6, as it was first announced way back in 2018, and fans have waited for more information on it ever since.

articles.title: Buying GTA 6 Could Save You $5,000, Or At Least This Guy Thinks So
articles.summary: Self-made millionaire Mark Tilbury has shared some advice for how buying GTA 6 can actually save you $5,000. Just don't take this too seriously. Here's how he arrived at that number: If the game costs $100 (for the Ultimate Edition) and it takes 80 hours to complete, that works out to $1.25/hour of…
body: If you play for four hours every evening, that's 50 nights of entertainment. Tilbury said people should compare this to a night out where they could easily spend $100 in a night.

Even if it's not a full $100, Tilbury is spot-on that going out to do most things today costs a pretty penny. So staying in to play GTA 6 may indeed "save" you some money you might have spent elsewhere. You may also play a lot of GTA 6 and continue to go out and spend money on other things.
His math also might be conservative, as people are no doubt going to play GTA 6 for far more than 50 days, especially when GTA Online 2.0 releases in 2027, as expected.
Clearly, though, Tilbury is being cheeky here and created the clip for virality and for people to send to their friends and partners to justify how much they are going to play GTA 6.
points: Self-made millionaire Mark Tilbury has shared some advice for how buying GTA 6 can actually save you $5,000.

articles.title: LEGO Godzilla Announced, Releases on Black Friday
articles.summary: Each year, LEGO releases a major new set on Black Friday. The block-building company has just announced this year’s set: It’s LEGO Godzilla, a 5,363-piece build that will cost $449.99 ( see it at LEGO ).
body: This gray-and-blue beast from the Monsterverse stands over 27.5 inches tall and can be posed in a number of different ways. If you buy it between November 27 - 30 while supplies last, you’ll also get a LEGO Godzilla Logo & Footprint set for free as a Gift With Purchase.

Fitting with the subject, this is a large, imposing set, with the city-destroying monster standing over two feet tall. The beast’s skin is made up of overlapping gray LEGO bricks, some smooth, and some with “ greebling ” to create a scaly effect. His dorsal fins are jagged and detailed, made of blocks with varying shades of blue. The overall effect makes it look organic and fiery – it’s very cool.

When you have it built, you can adjust the position of Godzilla’s tail to the left or right. You can also move its head, arms, wrists, and fingers. It comes with a tongue you can put in his mouth, or a blue Heat Ray to add a more dynamic, destructive vibe to the King of Monsters.

articles.title: South Of Midnight Director Says He Would Not Have Funded The Game
articles.summary: Xbox funded and published 2025's South of Midnight, a highly acclaimed action-adventure game set in the American Deep South. The game's creative director, David Sears, said he believes South of Midnight is a "generational" game that he hopes people discover and play for a long time and one that he…
body: At the same time, Sears said he wasn't sure Microsoft's spending spree under the previous leaders Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond--which is how Sears' studio Compulsion got the funding to make South of Midnight--was going to work out long term.

"I literally told people, I was like, 'Yeah, wow, this could be terrible.' Because somebody is going to say, someday, 'The money tap... we're closing those floodgates.' And that's going to have really traumatic results downstream," he told Ben Hanson on MinnMax.

Microsoft spent billions and billions of dollars to buy studios and franchises to help get Xbox Game Pass off the ground. The bet did not work out, and now Spencer and Bond are out. The new Xbox CEO is Asha Sharma, and one of her first moves was to cut costs dramatically with layoffs, studio divestures--including Compulsion--and game cancellations. Sharma also talked about how Game Pass needs to evolve into something that's "more enticing to a broader range of customers.”
Asked directly if he had been in control of the Xbox funding at the time, would Sears have stopped writing checks for games like South of Midnight? "Yeah, probably," he answered ( via Kotaku ).

articles.title: Indie Game Storefront Itch Deletes a 'Couple of Terabytes of AI Slop,' Adds 'No AI' Filter to Search Results
articles.summary: Itch has clamped down on the deluge of low effort generative AI games flooding its store, confirming the removal of a couple of terabytes of "AI slop." In a statement on social media, the indie game storefront said it had begun the process of removing thousands of AI games and other marketplace…
body: "Just because you can upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI generated models doesn't mean you should upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI generated models," Itch continued.

Itch has also added generative AI disclosure filtering to its website, including on its search results page "in order to better control what you see." Via the 'No AI' filter, users can strip out games with AI disclosures.

When asked if this was a blanket ban on generative AI, Itch said it’s only against the site’s terms and conditions when it comes to spam. “Avoid uploading excessive amounts of automatically generated or AI-generated content,” the site’s official terms and conditions states. AI generated content is fine if it’s “clearly stated in your project description and that it adds substantial value to the user experience.” Multiple iterations of the same thing spat out with slight variations are against the rules, and AI content has to have some sense of curation to pass the store’s guidelines.

articles.title: Remedy’s Big Bet On Control Resonant Appears To Be Paying Off
articles.summary: Following the September release of Control Resonant, business is boomin' for developer Remedy Entertainment. The studio reported that its third-quarter revenue surged 226% to €39.6 million / $44.3 million after the game's release, following the financial review period on October 15, a feat CEO…
body: In terms of operating profit, Remedy said it made €0.6 million / $670,794, and while that may not sound like much, it's still better than the €16.4 million / $18.3 million loss the studio posted in the same quarter last year. Control Resonant has sold over 1 million units, making it Remedy's fastest-selling title to date, with most sales coming from the US. The game has also been popular in the US and the UK, and Remedy says that half of the players were new to the franchise.

"Reaching new players was a key goal for this game, and these early results indicate a growing audience for the franchise and for Remedy," Gaudechon said, adding that the developer is looking to get the game into the hands of more people. Control Resonant's predecessor, Control, also saw increased sales, and that financial runway will help Remedy as it continues working on other projects, like its Max Payne 1 & 2 remake. Gaudechon also noted that Control Resonant is currently on 2.4 million wishlists, which could provide a "substantial potential audience" for the future.

articles.title: Scream Star Confirms She’s Returning for Sequel
articles.summary: One of the definitive scream queens is coming back for another night with Ghostface. Neve Campbell confirmed she will return as Sidney Prescott (now Evans) in Scream 8.
body: “ Scream 8, that’s in the pipeline as well,” Campbell said to AP. “You know I can’t tell you anything about Scream 8, ” the actress said, “I’ll be in it.” Campbell has appeared in every film in the series except 2023’s Scream 6.

Paramount and Spyglass announced that they would begin developing an eighth movie on March 31, 2026, with sisters Lilla and Nora Zuckerman handling the script. The Zuckermans are television writers who have worked together on series like Poker Face, Suits, Fringe, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., and more.

It isn’t particularly surprising that another Scream film is on the way. Earlier this year, Scream 7 became the highest-grossing movie in the series’ history, bringing in $214 million against a $45 million budget. Series creator Kevin Williamson directed and co-wrote the picture.

However, despite its big-box office performance, critics almost universally panned the film, calling it shallow and the franchise's worst entry. It has a 29% score on Rotten Tomatoes, putting it dead last on the Tomatometer behind Scream 3, the only other series installment with a negative score on the review aggregator.

body: At Anime NYC in August, it was revealed that Season 2 would arrive early next year. Now we know exactly when. Netflix has announced that Blue Eye Samurai will return on Jan. 19, 2027. Unfortunately, the second season will have only six episodes, two fewer than the first's eight. However, the wait for a third season shouldn't be as long, since Netflix has announced plans for the series to conclude in 2028.

The release date trailer mainly serves as a refresher on the events of the show so far. Season 1 introduced audiences to Mizu, a half-white, half-Japanese woman trained in swordsmanship. She disguises herself as a man and embarks on a quest to kill four European men (one of whom is her father). This culminated in a confrontation with one of those men, Abijah Fowler, who attempted to overthrow the ruling shogunate.

articles.summary: Thanks to a multiplayer renaissance, we’re currently living in a golden age of couples games. Whether you and your significant other are playing Split Fiction or pairing up for Big Walk, there are no shortage of great trust-building co-op games out there currently.
body: A sequel to 2022’s Escape Academy, the latest game from Coin Crew Games doubles — even triples — down on split-screen play to deliver a bounty of digital escape rooms that will test your communication skills. Though a newfound emphasis on story mostly falls flat, Escape Academy 2 ’s balance between clever puzzles and approachable play makes for a killer date-night choice.

Though it's a sequel, Escape Academy 2 very much feels like the real start of Coin Crew Games’ series. The first Escape Academy was a well-designed puzzle game made by people with experience creating real-world escape rooms, but its very short runtime left it feeling like an appetizer. Additional DLC helped beef up the package, but Escape Academy 2 feels far more complete out of the gate as a longer game with more thought put into how all its various puzzle rooms connect.

articles.title: COD: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ patch has nerfed UAV Towers so you're not immediately visible everywhere you go
articles.summary: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 patches continue, with the latest delivering some big changes to the game's extraction mode DMZ. The latest hotfix introduced a key balance change to one of DMZ's most controversial mechanics: UAV Towers.
body: UAV Towers, previously guaranteed to spawn in every Point of Interest (POI) in the map, have now had their spawn logic randomised. Infinity Ward also reduced their spawn rate by 40 percent, meaning you're less likely to find them across the various regions of the map. As noted in the patch notes, that change also prevents multiple towers from spawning the same area. The only exception is the Deadtown area, which factors into DMZ Order progression and requires multiple towers.

By taking away the guarantee that each POI will have at least one UAV Tower, the patch removes one of the core tactics PvP-inclined and aggressive players have been relying on since DMZ's launch. It's common for players to spawn in, and immediately run around activating as many UAV Towers as possible to reveal the movement of enemy players, even if they're not interested in directly engaging them.

Indeed, some of the UAV Towers cover extraction areas, so it's easy for players intending to ruin the day of others as they're extracting to set up elaborate traps. Making matters worse, a particular character trait prevents UAV Towers from expiring, allowing the scans to stay up for the entire match.
points: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 patches continue, with the latest delivering some big changes to the game's extraction mode DMZ.

body: In a packed new Direct, Rich dissects the PC version of Phantom Blade Zero - does it run well on mainstream hardware? What about RT and path tracing? Meanwhile, Oliver discusses the latest Apple hardware, there's conjecture on a potential Switch 2 Lite, Rich gets to grips with the more efficient FSR 4.1 for handhelds, while John looks to get an "anti PS5 Pro patch" fixed for Castlevania: Belmont's Curse. The show reaches a crescendo with the team celebrating ten years of PS4 Pro - and the Digital Foundry Supporter Program!
